notes: 3D flip card. Front: title + subtitle + icon. Back: title + description + CTA. Trigger: hover (desktop, tap mobile), click (everywhere). Textonly: pipeline routes to CardReveal — maps title/subtitle/description/href/linkLabel. Reduced: instant swap, no 3D.

content._description: What the card says — survives all render modes

href.description: CTA link URL on back face.

visual._description: How the card looks — stripped in textonly

frontImage.description: Background image URL for front face.

backImage.description: Background image URL for back face.

frontIcon.description: Icon slug for front face (no image).

trigger.description: Flip trigger. hover = desktop hover + mobile tap. click = tap/click only.

animated.description: Enable 3D flip animation. false = instant swap.

colour._description: Pipeline-overridable colour tokens. Defaults match CSS.

hoverAccent.description: Border + heading + icon colour on hover.
